tool.title: Knowledge graph viewer
tool.description: Render the instance's published knowledge graph as one page: facets by kind and sub-graph, search, a node's properties, its edges and back-links, and the graph's own gaps — reading the JSON-LD document at the site root rather than carrying a copy.

inputs.name: check
inputs.description: Fail if a page is stale, instead of writing.

inputs.name: site
inputs.description: A site being built: write the pages at their declared route under it instead of under the harness's own site directory. A repository's own site build passes it (the tools layer's `visualiser-writers.ts`), since its harness docs are a pinned mount.

outputs.name: pages
outputs.description: The viewer pages, under the published site directory.

$comment.comment:
A viewer generator (`viewerTool` in `../lib.ts` holds the ports every viewer shares).
It draws the instance's published graph document, which `kg:export` builds from
its own skills, scenarios, processes, Tools and schemas — so it renders those kinds.
